in_sanskrit.name: Hruthika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Heart-pleaser
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Hruthika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘hruth’ meaning heart and ‘ka’ meaning pleaser. It suggests one who delights the heart.

in_hindi.name: Hruthika

in_telugu.name: Hruthika
in_telugu.long_meaning: Hruthika ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘hruth’ meaning heart and ‘ka’ meaning pleaser. It suggests one who delights the heart.

in_marathi.name: Hruthika

in_bengali.name: Hruthika
in_bengali.long_meaning: Hruthika একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘hruth’ meaning heart and ‘ka’ meaning pleaser. It suggests one who delights the heart.
